propositions: A plan asserts that a named module provides a capability that it does not actually provide, causing the plan to rely on nonexistent functionality
A plan asserts that a capability must be built or is absent when the named module already provides that capability, causing unnecessary duplication
The new advisory criterion asserted-capability must register in CANONICAL_LLM, CODEBASE_GROUNDED, and AGENT_TIER with default_posture advisory and facet codebase-grounding
The criterion plugs into the existing four-pass finder/verifier/decide/coach machinery dispatched as an agentic E4 detector with two symmetric sub-answers (capability present vs absent)
The probe must fire on all three E1-verified miss cases (dc58, db7b, 5886) when grounded against current module code and fire advisorily (never blocking) on clean plans
The criterion auto-flows into the standing criterion_effectiveness recorder with zero per-criterion wiring and enables future advisory-to-blocking promotion via dogfood gate
